verdict.rationale: Twenty's docs say users can add custom fields with 20+ field types and switch between table, kanban and calendar views. Those views support AND/OR filtering, multi-field sorting, grouping and saved custom views, which covers the core of the story; a community comment also calls the customization easy to set up and promising. missing for 10: explicit evidence that saved views can be shared with teammates (only dashboards are documented as workspace-level), confirmation that non-admin ops users can add fields without admin rights or a separate setup project, independent hands-on corroboration of the view features.
